title: Yummy German Flaxseed Stew
description: A light, floral stew packed with flaxseeds and fermented soybean paste, perfect for a sick day and free of onion and garlic.

ingredients.name: dried flaxseeds
ingredients.notes: to be added at the end

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced carrot and potato and sauté for 5 minutes until they begin to soften.
Pour in the vegetable broth and stir in the fermented soybean paste, white wine vinegar, thyme, dill, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.
Add the chopped kale and continue simmering for another 5 minutes until the kale is tender.
Stir in the flaxseeds and cook for an additional 5 minutes, letting the seeds absorb the broth and thicken the stew slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot.
Serve one portion in each of five bowls, optionally garnishing with a sprinkle of fresh dill.
